Thanks Ben — thanks Anna for the attachments. A couple of clarifying asks from FinOps so we can validate the bank file and remittance mapping: 

Banking attestation / letter requirements (we look for these fields):
- Legal account holder name (must match W-9)
- Bank name, routing number (ABA) and account number (full encrypted in our portal; last 4 visible in emails)
- For wires: SWIFT/BIC / beneficiary address (if applicable)

Remittance format / PO mapping:
- Your sample_remit XML shows <PORef>. We need one of the following to reconcile automatically: 
  - PO number in <PORef> (preferred) OR
  - Invoice number + billing reference in separate elements (we will require a project_code element if you have split billing across internal projects).

Action items:
1) Anna — please confirm whether OrbitLogix will include PO number in <PORef> going forward. If not, please provide a short mapping doc with element names we should ingest.
2) Anna — sign the banking attestation (DocuSign link below) so we can enable ACH on your profile.
3) Naomi — I'll send to payments team for test ACH once signed attestation and intake are complete.

DocuSign (banking attestation): https://docusign.example/doc/ABC123

Naomi/Ben — I estimate 1–2 business days from signed attestation to PO creation + test ACH.

Regards,
